title: Paul Graham Keynote Speech At OPT412
summary: Paul Graham gives a keynote in his hometown of Pittsburgh, reflecting on the old and new city and arguing that it could become a startup hub.
why: Cited as the video version of his essay on making Pittsburgh a startup hub, and as a talk that persuaded at least one commenter to move there.

quote.text: It also happens to be one of the few available on youtube[1] if you would rather watch than read.
